triggers.description: The user explicitly asks to merge, land, or finish one GitHub pull request.
The selected PR has unresolved review threads, active requested changes, or explicit current review blockers that Land must reconcile before merge.
exclusions: bare thread IDs without concern context

triggers.description: Live PR state must be classified before any review-resolution, merge, or cleanup mutation.
A merged PR's local branch, remote branch, or associated worktree requires cleanup.
exclusions: detached worktree at the same commit

routes.description: Read, classify, repair or disposition, evidence, and resolve every unresolved review thread before fresh merge admission.
Supersede the immutable landing epoch after a repair or authorized update publishes a successor head, then rebuild all evidence.
Merge the exact admitted head immediately with an exact-head guard, then prove live merged state.
Admit the exact head to the merge queue without inventing direct-merge freshness, then wait for live merged state.
Enable explicitly selected auto-merge for the exact admitted head and wait for live merged state.
Skip merge mutation because the exact PR/head is already merged and perform guarded cleanup only.
Emit LAND-v2 after review closure, live merged-state proof, and independently verified cleanup outcomes.
Preserve state only after proving no safe authorized review, admission, postcondition, or cleanup transition remains.

success_signals: all live identity fields match one immutable landing epoch
failure_signals: branch-name-only targeting
changed head silently retargeted
mismatched repository or PR
clauses.rationale: Irreversible actions require an exact repository and head epoch.

success_signals: every safe unresolved concern enters repair or evidence-backed disposition
a repairable concern never produces terminal obstruction before attempted repair
failure_signals: unresolved thread reported as terminal merely because merge is not ready
repairable concern delegated back to the user
clauses.rationale: Merge admission failure is not workflow terminality while review closure can progress.

success_signals: every resolved thread has one individual evidence-bearing disposition
fixed current concern is evidenced at a successor head
final live unresolved thread set is empty before merge
failure_signals: bulk resolution from bare thread IDs
isOutdated treated as proof of obsolescence
current substantive concern resolved at an unchanged head
generic user continuation treated as withdrawal
clauses.rationale: GitHub resolution metadata records semantic discharge; it cannot manufacture it.

success_signals: every material head mutation starts a new immutable landing epoch
failure_signals: admission evidence reused across a push
old epoch silently retargeted to a successor head
clauses.rationale: Review repair changes the object being admitted and invalidates all prior admission evidence.

success_signals: merge admission is derived from the current epoch
queue admission does not invent direct strict branch freshness
failure_signals: canceled required check treated as green
behind queue candidate blocked solely by direct-merge freshness
administrator bypass selected
clauses.rationale: Only current-head, route-correct admission evidence may authorize merge mutation.

failure_signals: missing match-head guard
delete-branch bundled into merge
admin retry
clauses.rationale: The mutation must fail rather than land a different head or negate repository policy.

failure_signals: queued or auto-enabled reported as merged
cleanup starts before MERGED readback
clauses.rationale: Command success and queue admission are not terminal landing proof.

success_signals: each cleanup surface reports an independent verified result
failure_signals: detached worktree deleted by OID
dirty or locked worktree forced away
branch ref drift ignored
cleanup failure rewrites merge outcome
clauses.rationale: Cleanup is a preservation-first post-merge saga with independent facts.

instrumentation.rationale: LAND-v2 is the required operational receipt; emit SDR-v1 only when route selection needs separate tuning evidence.
